Movate Format JD

Job Title: GenAI Migration Engineer (Python, Snowflake & dbt)

Experience: 5-7 Years
Location: Remote / Bengaluru / Chennai / Hyderabad
Employment Type: Full-Time

Job Summary

Movate is seeking a highly skilled GenAI Migration Engineer to design and develop AI-powered modernization solutions for enterprise data transformation and legacy system migration initiatives. The ideal candidate will build and enhance GenAI-driven pipelines that automate the conversion of legacy SQL code, stored procedures, data models, and warehouse constructs into modern cloud-native architectures using Snowflake and dbt.

This role requires strong expertise in Python development, LLM integration, Prompt Engineering, Snowflake, dbt, and AI-assisted automation frameworks. The candidate will work closely with Data Architects, Data Modellers, and Data Engineering teams to improve conversion accuracy, automate validation, and accelerate cloud migration programs.

Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and maintain GenAI-powered code modernization and migration pipelines.
Build AI-driven solutions to automate conversion of legacy SQL, ETL, stored procedures, and data warehouse objects into Snowflake-compatible implementations.
Develop Python-based orchestration frameworks for LLM integrations and automated migration workflows.
Collaborate with Data Architects and Data Modellers to understand source systems and target-state architectures.
Design and optimize prompts for code conversion, SQL transformation, and migration use cases.
Automate validation and quality assurance of AI-generated outputs.
Implement confidence scoring mechanisms and human-in-the-loop review processes.
Build scalable migration frameworks for enterprise data modernization programs.
Develop dbt models, transformations, and testing frameworks to support cloud migration initiatives.
Validate data warehouse conversions from legacy platforms to Snowflake.
Create reusable frameworks, templates, and accelerators for migration projects.
Monitor, measure, and improve AI conversion accuracy and performance metrics.
Maintain prompt repositories, version control, and experiment tracking processes.
Work closely with engineering teams to ensure migration outputs meet enterprise quality standards.

Required Qualifications

5-7 years of experience in Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or Data Platform Development.
Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience with LLMs, Generative AI, or AI-powered automation pipelines.
Strong expertise in Python development and automation frameworks.
Hands-on experience with Snowflake implementation, migration, or development.
Strong experience with dbt transformations and cloud data engineering practices.
Experience working with SQL-heavy applications, databases, and data warehouse environments.
Knowledge of modern cloud-based analytics architectures.
Experience evaluating and validating AI-generated outputs.
Excellent problem-solving and analytical capabilities.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in legacy system modernization or migration projects.
Exposure to SAP HANA, Oracle, Teradata, SQL Server, or other enterprise databases.
Experience with Data Vault, Kimball, and Medallion Architecture concepts.
Hands-on knowledge of RAG-based applications and vector database implementations.
Snowflake Certification and/or dbt Certification.
Experience with Azure, AWS, or GCP cloud environments.
